items.author: devenrue.com
items.context: My latest obsession is Teddy's Haven. Its a magic shop sim that is exactly what it says on the tin. I love it. I find that it is one of the best games I've gotten to play in a long while that is genuinely relaxing. And I get to name all the animals?! Like sheep named "warm socks" and "Matt-ewe"! 😆
items.text: Naming the animals sounds like a delight, a sheep called 'warm socks' is perfect. Glad you found something that really relaxes you.
